blocks.text: Wireless access point Wi-Fi connectivity (Wi-Fi se jurne ki suhulat) deta hai. Yeh wireless devices ko network se jurne deta hai (jaise Figure 1.7 mein). Yeh wireless network ki coverage (signal kitni door tak pohanchta hai) barhata hai. Access points bari buildings aur campuses (university ya school ke bare ahate) mein istemal hote hain. Yeh signal ki strength (taqat) aur stability (signal ka barabar rehna) behtar karte hain. Wireless access points mobile connectivity (chalte phirte jure rehna) mein madad dete hain.

blocks.alt: Antenna wala wireless access point neeche rakhe mobile phone, laptop aur desktop computer ki taraf Wi-Fi lehrein aur signal bhejta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.7: Wireless access point (kitab ki Figure 1.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Ek bari college building mein access points kyun lagaye jate hain?
blocks.explanation: Taake Wi-Fi ki coverage poori building mein pohanche, signal mazboot aur barabar rahe aur students chalte phirte jure rahein.

items: Wireless access point: Wi-Fi deta hai, coverage barhata hai, signal mazboot karta hai; bari buildings aur campuses.
